sentences.text:
Also heard Mr. Sangharsh Pandey, learned Government Advocate,
appearing for the State.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the impugned FIR, bearing Crime No.225 of 2022, for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 468 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), was registered on 16.04.2022 against the petitioners.
However, the investigation has not yet been concluded.
It is further submitted that petitioners No. 1 to 4 have already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 26.08.2025 in MCRCA No. 1293 of 2025.
Digitally  signed by  BRIJMOHAN BRIJMOHAN MORLE MORLE

The Director General of Police, State of Chhattisgarh, is directed to file his personal affidavit, through the concerned Superintendent of Police, explaining why the Investigating Officer has failed to conclude the investigation of the present case in pursuance of FIR bearing Crime No. 225 of 2022, registered on 16.04.2022 at Police Station Civil Lines, District Raipur (C.G.), for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 468 of the IPC.
The affidavit must also specify what action has been taken against the Investigating Officer for keeping the investigation pending for more than three years.

A copy of this order be forwarded to the Director General of Police, Chhattisgarh, through the learned State Counsel, for information and necessary compliance forthwith.
List this matter in the next week.
 Sd/- Sd/-
 (Bibhu Datta Guru) (Ramesh Sinha)
